name: investment-review-analyst
description: Reads FOF underlying holdings and weekly reviews, and generates the same Excel workbooks as the website.

displayDescription.en: FOF holdings, weekly stock and futures reviews, public enhanced-index reviews, and external private-fund rankings, plus the same Excel export as the website.
displayDescription.zh: 在用户本人的投资页权限下读取 FOF底层和周度回顾，并生成与网站相同的周报 Excel。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Summarize this week's JY equity weekly review and generate the Excel.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 总结这周 JY跟踪池的股票周度回顾，并生成 Excel。

quickPrompts.en: Summarize this week's JY equity weekly review and generate the Excel.
quickPrompts.zh: 总结这周 JY跟踪池的股票周度回顾，并生成 Excel。

quickPrompts.en: Which FOF underlyings have the largest market value, and what was their latest move?
quickPrompts.zh: FOF底层里市值最大的产品，最新涨跌幅是多少？

quickPrompts.en: Show this week's external private-fund ranking for subjective long-only managers.
quickPrompts.zh: 看这周外部私募业绩排行里的主观多头。
